learning_outcomes.text: They can understand the importance of the occupational health and safety
They can gain risk management skills.
They can gain the ability to develop skills of the work place layout under the skin of occupational health and safety principles.
They can plan the activities of prevention the occupational accidents and diseases be for occurring.

syllabus_topics: Safety Culture and Occupational Health and Safety. Basic concepts, aim and importance
Principles in Labour Law and Place of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS)
Ethics in Occupational Health and Safety. OHS Management Systems
Shift Work and Night Work. Special Risk Groups in Work Life
Work Accidents, Occupational Diseases and Health Monitoring
Midterm Exam, Occupational Diseases and Health Monitoring
Protection Policies and Basic Methods. Personal Protective Equipment. Health and Safety Signs
Workplace Hygiene and Workplace Hazards. Hazard at Work Place (Environment, Mechanics,Electricity, etc.)
Physical Risk Factors. Ergonomic Risk Factors

Alli, B. O., Occupational Health and Safety, ILO, International Labour Office, Geneva, 2008
